Basic joints and the two legs must read continuously and independently; hands have coherent fingers and wrists, no fused limbs, no furniture penetration. Natural soft local contact shadows and honest occlusion. Subtle almond-gold clear-day window light, distinct local hair/skin/clothing colors, clear gentle facial shadow planes, natural white paper and ivory fabric. Refined anime linework and soft anime shading integrated with the detailed literary room, no sticker edge, gray/gold overlay or new colored spotlight.
